risk_note: RV2 (platform/idempotency; identity controllers). Idempotent operations that opt in with keyedRequestDigest store request_hash as hmac1: + the FieldCrypto blind index (context idempotency.request_hash) of the canonical JSON instead of an unkeyed sha256, so the stored digest of a request body holding personal data cannot be brute-forced back (BR-WDR-07 as written back in couli #150; the hmac1: prefix records the blind-index key version, orchestrator decision 1). Rows without the prefix (legacy sha256) still compare against the sha256 of the same body during the retention window (dated TODO). FieldCrypto missing, throwing or returning a malformed value answers 50001 before any lookup and writes nothing, even when a legacy row exists. submitRealname and bindPhone opt in; savePayoutAccount and landingRegister are still planned and will opt in in their own tasks. The general path and requestHashOf are unchanged, so the frozen sha256 assertions still hold; no new error code.
